# CI/CD and repository rules

What runs on GitHub for this repository and which rules protect `main`, the optional `dev` and release tags. The rules apply once they are set up as described under [Repository settings](../../README.md#repository-settings) in the root README.

## On a pull request

These checks run on a pull request into `main` or `dev`:

| Check                    | Workflow                                                                                                        | Required to merge                                                                                                        |
| ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `verify / verify`        | `verify.yml`, passes only when `verify / base / verify` and `verify / bun` passed                               | yes                                                                                                                      |
| `verify / base / verify` | `verify.yml`, lints Dockerfiles with hadolint, shell scripts with shellcheck and workflow files with actionlint | through `verify / verify`                                                                                                |
| `verify / bun`           | `verify.yml`, runs format check, lint, typecheck, tests and build                                               | through `verify / verify`                                                                                                |
| `review / review`        | `scan-dependencies.yml`, fails on new dependencies with a vulnerability of severity high or critical            | yes                                                                                                                      |
| `analyze / analyze`      | `scan-codeql.yml`, CodeQL scan of the JavaScript and TypeScript code                                            | not as a check, but the ruleset on `main` blocks the merge on CodeQL errors or security alerts of severity high or above |
| `CodeQL`                 | posted by GitHub code scanning with the result of the CodeQL scan                                               | no                                                                                                                       |

## Workflows

The workflow files only hold the triggers. Their jobs live as reusable workflows in [aktin-github-scripts](https://github.com/aktin/aktin-github-scripts/tree/main/.github/workflows) and are called at `@main`. The actions are pinned to a commit SHA there.

What each workflow does and when it runs. A pull request means one into `main` or `dev`. Schedules are in UTC and run on `main`. A new run of `verify.yml` or `scan-codeql.yml` cancels an older run for the same branch or pull request:

| Workflow                | Pull request | Push to `main` | Schedule      | Other    | What happens                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| ----------------------- | ------------ | -------------- | ------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `verify.yml`            | yes          | yes            |               |          | Starts the shared `verify-web.yml`, which runs two jobs. The common lint checks the Dockerfiles with hadolint, the shell scripts with shellcheck and the workflow files with actionlint. It fails when hadolint reports an error, shellcheck a warning or worse, or actionlint any finding. The bun job installs the dependencies from `bun.lock` and runs the scripts `format:check`, `lint`, `typecheck`, `test` and `build`                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `scan-dependencies.yml` | yes          |                |               |          | Compares the dependencies before and after the pull request and fails when a newly added one has a known vulnerability of severity high or critical. On a failure it writes the findings as a comment into the pull request                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `scan-codeql.yml`       | yes          | yes            | Mondays 03:00 |          | Scans the JavaScript and TypeScript code for security mistakes and reports the findings in the Security tab                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `scan-scorecard.yml`    |              | yes            | Mondays 04:00 |          | Rates the security practices of the repository, for example branch rules, pinned actions, token permissions and code review, publishes the score to OpenSSF and feeds the badge in the root README. It changes nothing                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `release.yml`           |              |                |               | tag `v*` | Runs three jobs one after the other. `verify` runs the checks of `verify.yml` on the tagged commit. `build` builds the tagged commit with the version taken from the tag (`package.json` in the repository stays at 0.0.0), packs the bundle as `<repository>-web-<tag>.tgz`, for example `my-app-web-v1.2.0.tgz`, generates the SBOM `sbom-web.cdx.json` from `bun.lock` and attests build provenance and the SBOM at GitHub. `publish` writes the release notes from the commit history with git-cliff and creates the GitHub Release with both files attached. It fails when no file is found |

Dependabot is configured in `.github/dependabot.yml`. Once a week it opens one grouped pull request per ecosystem, one for the bun dependencies and one for the GitHub Actions. They go against `main`, or against `dev` when `target-branch: dev` is set. Dependabot alerts and security updates are switched on in the repository settings and report known vulnerabilities in dependencies that are already in use. Security updates always open their pull requests against `main`, also when `dev` is used. GitHub does not support them for bun yet, so these pull requests fail `verify / verify`.

## Gates on `main`

Branch ruleset `default` on `main`:

| Rule                     | Meaning                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Pull request required    | No direct pushes. Squash merge only, 1 approval, code owner review, approval after the last push, all review threads resolved. A new push dismisses earlier approvals. The code owners are listed in `.github/CODEOWNERS` |
| Required checks          | `verify / verify` and `review / review` must pass                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Code scanning            | CodeQL must have analysed the head commit without errors or security alerts of severity high or above                                                                                                                     |
| Signed commits           | Every commit on `main` is signed. Squash commits are signed by GitHub                                                                                                                                                     |
| No force push, no delete | History on `main` is append-only                                                                                                                                                                                          |

With the optional branch `dev` the branch ruleset `dev` applies to it: pull request required with squash merge only, 1 approval and resolved review threads, the same required checks, signed commits, no force push and no delete. `main` then takes merge commits only, which GitHub signs as well.

Approvals come from people. GitHub Actions cannot create or approve pull requests, and no app or bot is on the bypass list. Only the admins on the bypass list can skip a rule. Other branches have no rules.

## Gates on tags `v*`

Tag ruleset `release-tags`: only maintainers and admins can create, move or delete release tags. A tag starts the release workflow, so this decides who can cut a release.
